topic: 高可用协同与状态持久化
title: 真实旧快照恢复：已取消静默重新生效，按外部取消审计精确对账并保留仍有效维护
source: OpsForge 系统方向独立编审 2026-10-21
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 备份反映旧时刻状态，恢复后其静默窗口可能仍有效，与当前维护计划不一致。
恢复后对账静默ID/范围/期限和审计记录，不能只验证进程启动。

conversion.original_title: 恢复旧数据目录为何可能重新引入已取消静默？

body:
## 操作任务
实现reconcile(base,cancellations,request)。cancellations是恢复点之外保存的、经审批的取消记录，每条含精确id/matchers/endsAt；request返回HTTP状态及JSON。逐条GET /api/v2/silence/{id}，无记录或非200则ValueError，已expired跳过；否则核对id、完整matcher列表及原期限与审批完全相同，不符ValueError且该条不得删除。只对批准且匹配的ID发DELETE，非200抛RuntimeError，再GET确认expired后计入返回ID列表。不得批量清掉其他活动静默，不能从旧备份自身反推哪些静默曾被取消，不改原审批输入。真实测试创建两个维护静默、保存silences原生持久化文件，取消其中一个并证明真实告警解除抑制；从旧文件恢复到另一独立数据目录后同ID重新active并真实抑制告警，执行对账只取消该ID、保留另一维护静默及范围，重复执行幂等，错误批准scope拒绝。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
官方Alertmanager0.28.1 Windows原生进程，实际silences持久化快照、独立源/恢复数据目录及真实API抑制状态。加速维护快照间隔仅限私有验收进程；没有恢复生产目录、改默认服务、演练HA去重或验证完整灾难恢复，通知接收器无外部通道。外部取消审计由题给可信来源提供，不声称建立企业审计系统。只计此原ID实操，不把两个静默、源/恢复两进程或故障注入分别计题/原故障。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import copy,hashlib,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,sys,tempfile
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/"checks"))
import task
from silence_restore_fixture import request,wait_for,native,silence,alerts
binary=shutil.which("alertmanager") or shutil.which("alertmanager.exe")
assert binary and "0.28.1" in subprocess.check_output([binary,"--version"],stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,timeout=5)
print("NATIVE_PLATFORM_READY",flush=True)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="opsforge-silence-restore-") as temp:
 root=pathlib.Path(temp);data=root/"source-data"
 with native(root/"source",data) as base:
  cancelled=silence(base,"old-host");keep=silence(base,"still-maintenance");cid=cancelled["id"];kid=keep["id"]
  get=alerts(base);wait_for(lambda:get()["old-host"]==[cid] and get()["still-maintenance"]==[kid])
  snapshot=data/"silences";wait_for(lambda:snapshot.is_file() and snapshot.stat().st_size>0)
  old=snapshot.read_bytes();old_sha=hashlib.sha256(old).hexdigest()
  assert request("DELETE",base+"/api/v2/silence/"+cid)[0]==200
  wait_for(lambda:request("GET",base+"/api/v2/silence/"+cid)[1]["status"]["state"]=="expired")
  wait_for(lambda:not get()["old-host"] and get()["still-maintenance"]==[kid])
 restored_data=root/"restored-data";restored_data.mkdir();(restored_data/"silences").write_bytes(old)
 assert hashlib.sha256((restored_data/"silences").read_bytes()).hexdigest()==old_sha
 with native(root/"restored",restored_data) as base:
  status,returned=request("GET",base+"/api/v2/silence/"+cid)
  assert status==200 and returned["status"]["state"]=="active"
  get=alerts(base);wait_for(lambda:get()["old-host"]==[cid] and get()["still-maintenance"]==[kid])
  print("NATIVE_ALERTMANAGER_OLD_SNAPSHOT_RESTORED_CANCELLED_SILENCE_ACTIVE_AND_REAL_ALERT_SUPPRESSED_AGAIN",flush=True)
  approved=[{k:copy.deepcopy(cancelled[k]) for k in ["id","matchers","endsAt"]}];original=copy.deepcopy(approved)
  print("STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: reconcile actual restored active silence against reviewed external cancellation",flush=True)
  result=task.reconcile(base,approved,request)
  assert result==[cid] and approved==original
  wait_for(lambda:not get()["old-host"] and get()["still-maintenance"]==[kid])
  assert request("GET",base+"/api/v2/silence/"+kid)[1]==keep
  assert task.reconcile(base,approved,request)==[]
  print("NATIVE_ALERTMANAGER_CANCEL_AUDIT_RECONCILED_ONLY_APPROVED_ID_OTHER_MAINTENANCE_PRESERVED_IDEMPOTENT",flush=True)
  # A different still-active ID cannot be cancelled using a mismatched approval scope.
  wrong=[{k:copy.deepcopy(keep[k]) for k in ["id","matchers","endsAt"]}];wrong[0]["matchers"][0]["value"]="unapproved-other-host"
  try:task.reconcile(base,wrong,request)
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError("scope-mismatched cancellation not rejected")
  assert request("GET",base+"/api/v2/silence/"+kid)[1]==keep
print("NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED",flush=True)
